direct_producers_jan2026.source_quote: Société Minière de Boké (SMB), which shipped 6.57 million tonnes of bauxite during the month across 32 vessels, accounting for roughly one-third of Guinea’s total shipments.
Chinese operator Aluminum Corporation of China (Chalco) ranked second with 2.64 million tonnes exported on 14 vessels, reflecting sustained throughput from its mining operations and port facilities.
Compagnie des Bauxites de Guinée, historically one of the country’s flagship bauxite producers, shipped 1.64 million tonnes on 28 vessels, maintaining a solid presence in the seaborne market.

Zhicheng Guinee Mining, operating in partnership with GBT logistics infrastructure, exported 0.94 million tonnes across five vessels, matching the 0.94 million tonnes shipped by China Dianjian Mining during the same period.

Iron ore.freight_note: Australia vs Brazil origin split directly dictates C5 (Pacific) vs C3 (Atlantic) Capesize demand; long-haul Atlantic voyages generate substantial ton-mile absorption.
